subject: MdePkg/IndustryStandard:: Add ACPI 6.6 extension for NUMA ACPI Tables
reasons: This commit adds new macro/constant definitions and renames a struct field (Reserved2 -> AddressMode) in a header file.
The changes are additive (new macros) plus a field rename in a struct definition — not a transformation of call sites.
While a field rename could in principle be handled by Coccinelle for call sites, this commit only touches the struct definition header, not consumers.
No repetitive C code pattern across multiple files.
